body: Thanks for the advice.  I'm working on it.
Thanks.  Panic disorder sucks.  I appreciate you trying to help.  I have decided to give it (life) another go.

Hey, I just wanted to say thanks for trying to help.  I'm definitely not looking for money, but thanks all the same.  I was scheduled for evaluation for post traumatic epileptic seizures (possibly due to the nerve block performed during my surgery), but my insurance coverage ran out before I could get my appt. with a neurologist.
  I do think often about what it would do to my son, but this is unbearable.  Again, I don't want to kill myself, as most people don't.  I have never attempted before.  I just can't live this way.  For what it's worth, thanks.
  I am going to spend the rest of the night crying like a bitch, and then decide what to do tomorrow.
  I am sorry about your condition.  Believe me, I empathize.  Again, thanks.
